gu-001: Low bridge — I had a consult and they raised it with donated cartilage. Dr. Kim Min-jun told me not to overdo the design, which actually made me trust him. Daily life was possible the same day; swelling lasted about ten days. Unless you catch a certain angle, it does not look operated.
np-001: Rhinoplasty at ID Hospital. Donated cartilage for the bridge. The surgeon talked me out of an aggressive design. Ten days of swelling, daily life immediately. Photos look natural unless you pick the angle.
gu-002: Buried-suture double eyelid. Long consult, they checked crease height several times. They warned it can loosen, which I appreciated. One side folds a little less — we will recheck in a month.
bt-002: Buried-suture double eyelid at Banobagi. Long consult, crease checked repeatedly. Loosening risk explained. One side is slightly shallower; follow-up in a month.
gu-003: Pop Plastic Surgery, bridge and tip only. I said I did not want a Western nose and they redrew the plan. Stitches out at one week, still careful about blowing my nose. Staff replies fast. No interpreter; we did not need one.
gu-004: Lower-eyelid fat repositioning. Bruising lasted longer than I expected — sunglasses for two weeks. Happy with the result, dark circles look lighter. Price shifted a bit from the consult, so four stars.
gu-005: Zygoma and chin together. Still a little swollen at month three. Front view is good, three-quarter still looks off. Wish recovery had been explained in more detail. The surgery itself felt clean.
gu-006: Thick lids so I went incisional. Dr. Choi sketched how much muscle and fat to take. Scar sits inside the crease. If you are considering double eyelid, take the consult here even if you operate elsewhere.
np-006: Thick lids, incisional crease. Surgeon sketched muscle and fat. Scar hidden in the line. Worth the consult alone.
gu-007: Masseter botox. Effect from week three. Chewing felt weak at first. Pricing is transparent and they have a retouch policy. The injections were quick.
gu-008: Revision after implant contracture at another clinic. Implant out, rebuilt with own tissue. Breathing is easier. Revision really is twice the money and time. Result is better than I expected.
gu-009: Square-jaw reduction. Waking from general anesthesia was rough and a week of liquids was miserable. At two months the line is cleaner. They warned about nerve numbness so the dull sensation was not a surprise.
gu-010: Bridge-only at Eight. Short surgery, short recovery. I asked for undetectable and it is. People only ask if I lost weight.
gu-011: Upper blepharoplasty plus ptosis repair. Sleepy eyes look more open. I worried about overcorrection; it still looks like me. Long wait at stitch removal.
gu-012: Third revision — I almost quit. Dr. Jung Hyun-woo explained the cartilage situation and told me not to get greedy. Breathing is open and the front line is stable. This is where I stop shopping around.
bt-012: Third nose revision. Surgeon showed the cartilage and told me not to get greedy. Breathing and front line are stable. Staying here for revisions.
gu-013: A nose-only clinic, and the consult was detailed. They looked at septum and appearance together. Breathing was half the goal — nights are less blocked. Swelling about two weeks.
gu-014: Contracted-nose reconstruction. Implant out, own cartilage in. Pain for two days, shape looked decent from week four. Nose-only clinic, no waiting room circus.
gu-015: First of three skin-booster sessions. Lots of needle marks. Makeup the next day. There is a glow; too early to judge. Staff speak English, easy to bring a foreign friend.
bt-003: Abdominal liposuction. The compression garment is the hard part. Goal was shape, not the scale. Uniforms fit better at one month. Bruising was wide for a week.
np-003: Same-day buried-suture double eyelid. Swelling for three days. I asked for a thin crease and work did not notice.
gu-016: Nasolabial filler, kept conservative. Two days of swelling. Big printed sign not to massage — useful.
gu-017: Rhinitis plus a low bridge. Consult felt steady, daily life the same day. No lingering issues. I would recommend it.
gu-018: SMAS facelift. Recovery is long, actually long. At three months the jawline is back. Scar hides behind the ear. Lower your expectations and then go.
bad-rating-1: It was excellent. The star widget let me hit 6 somehow. Happy with the nose.
bad-rating-2: Two-hour wait. Stars saved as 0 while I was still writing. Have not had surgery, consult only.
bad-rating-3: Happy with the revision. Their star UI looks like a foreign form and opened up to 7.
future-2: Surgery is booked for January; the review box was already open so this is consult-only. Implant size still undecided.
future-3: Booked laser for winter. The review posted before the appointment.
junk-proc-1: Listed under an event name, I still do not know what procedure it is. Came for a contouring consult only.
junk-proc-2: Package name hid the actual treatment. Receipt only says the event title — botox or booster, unclear.
mismatch-surgeon: Rhinoplasty at Pop with Dr. Kim Min-jun. Short wait, happy with the result. (The surgeon may belong to another hospital.)
price-low: Had contouring; the price field looks like a consult fee. The write-up is a surgery review.
unknown-clinic: The clinic name is so long I cannot search it. Somewhere in Gangnam. Had a nose job, satisfied.
gu-019: Thread lift. The tight feeling lasted a week. Effect is modest. They pushed a booster add-on, which felt heavy. Hygiene was fine.
np-004: Functional rhinoplasty. Breathing over appearance. Family noticed less snoring before I did. Recovery was mild.
bt-004: Zygoma reduction, intraoral incision. Eating was hard for a week. Front-view change is something only I notice, which was the point.
gu-020: First nose. Refused an implant, used own cartilage. Pain for two days. The profile line is what I like most.
